اذدكرن (form VIII)
# اِذْدَكَرْنَ (iḏdakarna) /ið.da.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اُذْدُكِرْنَ (uḏdukirna) /uð.du.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اِذْدَكِرْنَ (iḏdakirna) /ið.da.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
